questions.question: Please identify the page in Sylvia Nasar’s A Beautiful Mind for the tie game and the line about Nash equilibrium. The official page https://www.simonandschuster.net/books/A-Beautiful-Mind/Sylvia-Nasar/9781451628425 confirms the book and author, but not this episode. The source itself calls it a humorous legend, and that description is retained. The editor should agree how to describe the connection between the fictional scene and the cited biography.

Официальная страница https://www.simonandschuster.net/books/A-Beautiful-Mind/Sylvia-Nasar/9781451628425 подтверждает книгу и автора, но не этот эпизод.
